{{Item infobox | icon = Research Kit.png | description = Double-click to [[salvage]] a crafted item for [[Research Note|research notes]]. | type = salvage kit | rarity = fine | bound = account | id = 95906 }} [[Research Kit]] is a [[salvage kit]] that produces {{item icon|Research Note}}s currency and can be only used on [[item]]s that were [[crafting|crafted]] and have the Research [[Salvage#Salvage types|salvage type]]. It can be purchased from various [[vendor]]s in the ''[[End of Dragons]]'' and the ''[[Secrets of the Obscure]]'' expansion [[zone]]s, and has 250 charges. Research Kit represents a special type of [[Salvage|salvaging]] as it can be used as an alternative to other salvage types. A free and unlimited version of the Research Kit is built into the [[crafting]] user interface. Eligible crafted items will be automatically converted into Research Notes upon creation after checking the option "Automatically salvage output with a research kit". == Acquisition == === Sold by === * [[Master craftsman]] (excluding chef, jeweler and scribe) {{sold by}} === Other === * One free by mail per character upon first acquiring a [[Jade Bot]] [[Power Core]]. {{mail | sender = Xunlai Jade | subject = Congratulations on registering your jade bot! | content = Dear AUTO_REGISTERED_01, Thank you for registering your Xunlai Jade Bot! As part of our limited-time new-user giveaway, please find the enclosed research kit. You may use the research kit to deconstruct old crafted items to acquire valuable research notes. They can be used to craft new power cores and modules for your jade bot. Should you need another research kit in the future, one can be inexpensively purchased from a Xunlai technician near any jade bot workbench. Regards,
Xunlai Jade Customer Relations | reward = {{item icon|Research Kit}} | nosign = y }} == Used in == {{recipe list}} == Salvage results == * Salvage research can be found [[Research Note/Salvage research|here]]. * '''WARNING''': This will destroy any upgrades (runes, sigils, infusions) in the item, '''including''' from ascended items (unlike [[Ascended Salvage Tool]]). ;{{item icon|Research Note}} * 0-1 salvaged from: ** [[Rune]]s and [[sigil]]s *** Minor runes will not give any research notes. * 1-3 salvaged from: ** [[Utility item]]s ** Crafted [[food]] ** Crafted [[armor]] ** Crafted [[weapon]]s ** Crafted [[tonic]]s ;{{item icon|Research Paper}} * Contains 5 [[Research Note|research notes]]. * Salvaged from: ** Crafted [[relic]]s (1) ** [[Ascended feast|Ascended feasts]] (2) ** Crafted [[exotic armor]] (8-10) ** Crafted [[exotic weapon]]s (8-10) ** Crafted [[ascended weapon]]s (8-10) ;{{item icon|Research Notebook}} * Contains 25 [[Research Note|research notes]]. * Sometimes salvaged from: ** Crafted [[exotic armor]] (2-3) ** Crafted [[exotic weapon]]s (2) ** Crafted [[ascended armor]] (3-14) ;{{item icon|Pile of Research}} * Contains 100 [[Research Note|research notes]]. * Salvaged from: ** Crafted [[ascended armor]] (2) ** Crafted [[ascended weapon]]s (2-3) ;{{item icon|Mountain of Research}} * Contains 500 [[Research Note|research notes]]. * Salvaged from: ** Crafted [[ascended armor]] (1) (rare chance) ** Crafted [[ascended weapon]]s (1) (rare chance) [[de:Forschungskit]] [[es:Kit de investigación]] [[fr:Kit de recherche]]
